brief:
Mondoweiss reports that the Gaza Board of Peace represents the latest iteration of colonial powers weaponizing development plans against Palestinians. The board, like earlier schemes dating to the British Mandate period, aims to manage, fragment, and dispossess Palestinian populations through ostensibly progressive infrastructure and economic initiatives designed to reshape Palestinian land and governance structures.

Palestinians have mounted sustained resistance to such development frameworks throughout modern history. Opposition movements have challenged these plans across decades, viewing them as instruments of territorial control and demographic management rather than genuine economic benefit. Contemporary Palestinian resistance to the Gaza Board of Peace continues this long tradition of rejecting initiatives framed as development but structured to advance external political and strategic interests.
dek: The Gaza Board of Peace is the latest attempt by colonial powers to use “development” plans to manage, fragment, and dispossess Palestinians. Palestinians have resisted these plans in the past and continue to do so today.
title: Palestinians resist development schemes used to fragment territory
